LAREDO — A man in federal custody was booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday on a state jail felony charge of fraudulent use or possession of identifying information, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Pascual Santiz-Gonzalez was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 12:35 p.m. The booking record charges him with fraudulent use or possession of identifying information (fewer than 5 items) — a state jail felony under Texas law — and with a Class B misdemeanor charge of failure to identify, giving false or fictitious information. Bond had not been set on either charge as of booking, and U.S. Customs and Border Protection is listed as the holding agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Man in CBP custody arrested on state jail felony identity-fraud charge
